question: Test whether a local norm-preserving interaction yields positive equal shear weights beyond leading order.

objects.definition: One normalized opposite-pair sum per matching
objects.coefficient_domain: real with exact rational Gram replay

assumptions: Regular tetrahedral current and Frobenius input; Euclidean orthogonal registers and dimensionless time.
Matching blocks add an auxiliary record on each opposite pair.
Two-stage update declares a balanced split followed by full transfer of the retained pair-even mode.

technique_plan.technique: operator spectra and rational Gram replay
technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: distinguish transient and exact staged isotropy

integer_fraction_receipt.raw_count_expression: six edges in three opposite pairs

clock_receipt.clock_type: dimensionless continuous exchange or ordered two-stage update
clock_receipt.update_rule: equal-rate branch and prescribed balanced stage

dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: record-only projection omits residual odd source in staged branch

fitted_parameters_or_formula_choices: tested equal rates and selected half split
target_exposure.search_domain_and_budget: constant exchange and balanced split/full transfer

calculation_steps: Compare quadratic and quartic gain coefficients
Check three Gram terms sum to I after two stages
Write Section 9 addendum using 3 mu_minus - 2 mu_plus = c+6b

result.exact_expression: unit-rate Q-space contrast -t^4/3 + O(t^6); staged record metric (I+P)/2
result.precision_and_error: exact coefficients and exact finite Gram check
result.scope: Equal-rate continuous exchange gives the target at leading order but fails at quartic order; a fixed balanced exchange followed by a full matching swap realizes the ratio conditionally.

counterexamples_and_failures: Constant coupling fails equality on any positive open time interval
Including the retained source gives edge-space gain 1:1
limitations: Auxiliary matching channel and staged schedule assumed
No source selection or deficit allocation
No physical bridge or independent review
next_discriminant: Derive or rule out a native trigger for the balanced split and complete matching transfer, using conserved local receipts.
